Scatter Drop.name: Scatter Drop
Scatter Drop.description: The user opens a gate around a target who is standing still, held down or caught off guard, and drops them out of an exit at a place within reach the user can picture, such as a riverbank, a fenced lot or the far side of a police line. The target lands unhurt but stranded until they make their way back; a target who sees it coming can leap clear. Used on a hostage, it pulls them to safety. Strain: heavy.
